content.text:
When you **_lean over a dying person, suck out_** **_their final breath, and breathe it into the pendant_**, roll +CON: **on a 10+**, hold +1 Breath; **on a 7-9**, pick 1:

- Hold 1 Breath, but it tears at your lungs; mark *miserable* and suffer a nasty coughing fit.
- The pendant greedily sucks in the last breath, grows colder, and sighs; you, alas, gain no benefit. So long as you hold Breath, you are unfazed and unharmed by extreme cold. Spend 1 Breath to go without air for as long as an hour. When you **_remove the pendant_**, lose any Breath you hold.
